evidence_quotes.quote: Synology DS423+ official datasheet: Power consumption 28.30 W (Access) and 8.45 W (HDD Hibernation); 90 W AC power adapter (100V to 240V AC, 50/60 Hz); Noise level 19.8 dB(A) idle at 1 m.

Dimensions (H x W x D): 166 x 199 x 223 mm; Weight: 2.18 kg (2,180 g); Intel Celeron J4125 4-core (2.0-2.7 GHz); 2 GB DDR4 non-ECC (expandable up to 6 GB); 4x SATA bays + 2x M.2 2280 NVMe slots; 2x 1GbE RJ-45.
Official DS423+ compliance & compatibility matrix: FCC, CE, BSMI, VCCI, RCM, UKCA, EAC, CCC, KC, BIS, RoHS; verified USB-HID UPS auto-shutdown and Synology NVMe pool drive requirements.

adversarial_checks: NAS hardware & physics check: Verified 4 drive bays, 1 Gbps LAN (2x 1GbE), power hierarchy 8.45 W <= 28.3 W <= 90 W PSU peak, and acoustic order 19.8 dBA idle <= 26.5 dBA load.

DS423+ vs DS923+ engineering trap verified: Confirmed DS423+ retains Intel Celeron J4125 Quick Sync transcoding advantage over DS923+ (Ryzen R1600), but sacrifices 10GbE upgradeability and ships with only 2 GB RAM.
SM-02 & Korea official distributor check: Recorded US MSRP $499.99 vs KR official domestic KC retail 819,000 KRW (3-year Ablestor/PC Direct warranty) under msrp_benchmark_mode with asin: null.
